'''Chest loot''' is the set of items generated in containers of structures. [[Matcha Flavoured]] overrides nearly every vanilla chest loot table and adds new ones for its own structures, so that chests contain the pack's items: [[Obol]]s instead of {{MCW|Emerald|emeralds}}, [[Raw Diamond|raw diamonds]] instead of cut diamonds, [[crystal heart]]s, [[sacred texts]], [[estus ash]] and pack foods and equipment.

This page lists every chest loot table in the pack. The tables are generated from the pack's code; "chance per table" is the chance that the item appears at least once in one container. Each structure article shows the tables that belong to it.

== General changes ==
Across the pack's tables:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/simple_dungeon.json}}</ref>
* In the mineshaft, buried treasure and desert pyramid tables, cut [[diamond]]s are replaced by [[raw diamond]]s, which must be smelted in a [[Blast Furnace]]. Some tables still contain cut diamonds: bastion treasure, end city, nether fortress, stronghold corridor, several Trial Chambers tables, and the village toolsmith and weaponsmith. The desert pyramid gives raw diamonds, in line with the {{Version|1.12.2}} release notes, which say that no "naturally-occuring free diamonds" should appear in surface structures.
* Gold and iron ingots are mostly replaced by raw gold and raw iron.
* Vanilla armor, tools and weapons are replaced by calls to shared equipment tables (see [[#Equipment tables]]) or to the pack's own equipment tables, which give the pack's versions of the items.
* Vanilla foods such as bread, apples and golden apples are replaced by the pack's versions, so they stack with player-made food.
* [[Crystal Heart]]s, [[divine fragment]]s and [[sacred texts]] such as [[The Book of Enoch]], [[The Avesta]], [[The Quran]], [[The Tanakh]], [[The Divine Comedy]] and [[Paradise Lost]] appear in structure chests.
* Some entries have a <code>quality</code> value, so the {{MCW|Luck}} attribute affects them. The 1.12.1-alpha notes say the field was added to all chest tables, but in the current code only 14 chest tables use it, mostly on a few rare entries (the ancient city and bastion tables use it most).<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=Luck works, I've added the quality field to all chest loottables and even some other things.}}</ref>
* Rotten flesh, redstone and experience bottles are removed from all tables.

{{History line|0.5-alpha|date=June 29, 2026|All chest loot tables made translation-compatible.}}
{{History line|1.0|date=July 24, 2026|Bread found in chests is the same as player-made bread.
* Sweet Berry Jam removed from bastion chests.}}
{{History line|1.03|date=July 27, 2026|Divine Fragments added to Trial Chambers; mace drop odds increased.}}
{{History line|1.10|date=August 10, 2026|Added Abbey loot tables.
* Nerfed bastion treasure, buried treasure and Trial Chamber loot.
* Crystal Hearts added to mineshafts; The Avesta added to desert wells, and its chance in desert pyramids lowered from 50% to 33%.
* Sweet Berry Mash removed from stronghold corridor chests.}}
{{History line|1.12|date=August 12, 2026|Buffed buried treasure.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|date=September 1, 2026|Added the quality field to chest loot tables.
* Nautilus shells added to buried treasure; the Abbey tower chest always has The Quran or The Tanakh.
* Bonus chest added.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|date=September 19, 2026|Many loot tables buffed; cut diamonds replaced by raw diamonds.
* Silver added to ancient city chests and ominous vaults.
* Ruined portal loot nerfed so gold cannot be obtained before iron.
* The Quran and The Tanakh added to Trial Chamber loot.
* Trash removed from trial spawners and vaults.}}
